summary: Market reports retain notes with anchored selections while unanchored selectors use generic row fallback; validate user selectors before injecting notes. Dry-runs emit flat unfiltered JSON with empty results and notes, preserve snapshot plans without duplicating them in results, and bypass agent wrapping. Tags and trend refuse nested CSV with usage errors. Agent tests pin the nested results.results payload; manuscript and discovery document selection paths, agent wrapping, demand states and nullable shop names. Complete snapshot resumes reuse their initial read handle.
reason: Etsy-specific hand-written reports need a consistent consumable envelope while retaining legacy notes and snapshot summary metadata. Reprints must retain results nesting for tags/trend and preserve notes under selection and agent compaction; narrative paths must agree across discovery, docs and manuscript. Selector validation must reject total misses even when null row fields or unrelated empty arrays make generic matching indeterminate. Snapshot missing-file dry-runs retain their advisory note with the required empty notes array.
